patterns.note: No scroll-triggered reveals or animations; content scrolls statically into view without any parallax, sticky elements, or fade-ins.
Alternating background colors for major content sections, primarily using white and a very light blue, with a dark blue for the footer and one content section.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for all major section titles, creating clear hierarchy and impact.
A bright, clear blue is consistently used for primary calls to action, interactive elements, and accent icons.

technique_notes: The page employs a static scroll, where all elements and sections simply scroll into and out of the viewport without any additional animations, parallax effects, or sticky elements.
Major content sections alternate background colors (white, light blue, dark blue) to visually separate content blocks and aid readability, with content centered within a fixed-width container.
Interactive elements like buttons and content cards feature subtle rounded corners, providing a friendly and approachable feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body size) with standard, legible sans-serif body text, creating a clear and impactful hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections, creating an airy feel in the hero and top sections, transitioning to a more balanced density in feature grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a very light, almost pastel blue as a primary secondary background color, combined with a clean, spacious layout and bold typography, creates a friendly yet highly professional and trustworthy aesthetic that avoids the starkness often found in tech-focused designs.
